local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the single-coordinate diff against the library-new-request rules and contribution contract. The public, version-agnostic tests live in the com_github_loki4j.loki_logback_appender package, replace the scaffold placeholder, and drive Loki4j through its public API against a loopback push endpoint: Joran XML configuration of Loki4jAppender with JsonLayout, tenant and basic-auth headers, programmatic marker labels with drain on stop, 503 retry, the Apache HttpClient 4 and 5 senders, and Micrometer pipeline metrics; JsonLayout is also exercised directly. There are no native-image skips, error catches, test-side reflection, sleeps, or build flags, and every explicit I/O timeout is at least 10 seconds. The library reports 0/0 dynamic-access calls (the tracked JAR produces no call sites), so the coverage and entry-count gates do not apply; library line coverage is 69.27%. Only reachability-metadata.json files are present, generated by generateMetadata and split into library and test-only metadata. The Protobuf push path was left untested because it needs the separate loki-protobuf and snappy-java JNI artifacts. checkMetadataFiles, spotlessCheck, checkstyle, the generated-test and placeholder checks, statistics validation, and all three test lanes (GraalVM 25 current defaults, latest current defaults, latest future defaults) pass.
